header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners; nor intimation received.
body: Same was the position on last date of hearing viz 29-04-2025. Thereafter, no effort was made by the petitioner to proceed with the instant Petition; even the case was not listed before the Court for hearing. However, learned Additional A.G and Deputy P.G submit that interim challan has been submitted before the concerned court. Since no one is present on behalf of the petitioners, therefore, instant petition alongwith listed pending stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
